Dominic Barton Appointed Chair of Invest in Canada

Dominic Barton has been appointed as the new chair of Invest in Canada. This leadership change comes ahead of the Invest in Canada summit scheduled to take place in Toronto. The appointment was announced by Mark Carney. Barton's role is to lead the organization responsible for attracting foreign investment to Canada.
